duration.text: The Anesthesiology at Nanchang University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6944 USD/In total ￥ 50000 CNY/In total

requirements.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of graduate school 5.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6.Statement of your research plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. 7.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test)
